panels.rationale: External clinical photograph of a neonate's eye showing an extremely small, nonreactive pupil (pinhole microcoria), the caption stating 'Narrow nonreactive pupils (microcoria)'. This is a hallmark ocular manifestation of Pierson syndrome (LAMB2-related oculorenal syndrome), and the article title and in-text mention ("bilateral microcoria (Fig. 2)") directly attribute it to Pierson syndrome in this patient.
